resources.string: %1$s search terms — e.g. %1$s Muse Uprising\nFinds a YouTube video and sends its title and link to the current chat.
%1$s topic — e.g. %1$s Rome\nSearches Italian Wikipedia and sends a short description and link to the chat.
%1$s expression — e.g. %1$s (12+3)*2\nCalculates locally with +, −, *, /, %%, ^ and parentheses; sends the result to the chat.
%1$s film title — e.g. %1$s Inception\nSearches TMDB and sends film details and a link to the chat; requires an API key.
%1$s [place] — e.g. %1$s Tokyo or %1$s Europe/Rome\nSends the date and time to the chat; without a place, uses the device time zone.
%1$s word — e.g. %1$s casa\nSearches Italian Wiktionary and sends a definition and link to the chat.
How to obtain a TMDB API key
Opens the official TMDB guide in your browser. Registration is easier on a PC.
